issues.issue: Verification of non-retrospectivity under Article 20(1) regarding criminal referrals.
issues.response: Clause 10 explicitly prohibits ex post facto criminal penalization and restricts referrals to pre-existing offences under the Prevention of Corruption Act.

issues.issue: Preservation of Article 300A property rights in asset recovery petitions before High Courts.
issues.response: Clause 8 places sole quashing and recovery authority with High Court Division Benches after full trial and due notice.
